_comment: Per-voice decoding settings. Edit and send the next request — no restart,
and the render cache keys on these values so you never hear a stale clip.
Settings are nested by engine because the same key means different things
to each model: repetition_penalty defaults to 1.2 in Chatterbox and 5.0 in
XTTS. A flat block (no engine name) applies to whichever engine is running.
exaggeration  delivery intensity. 0.5 neutral, higher = more theatrical.
cfg_weight    how tightly generation is steered. The model card suggests
lowering it for fast-talking references, which loosens the
pacing and gives the words more room.
The values below are starting points reasoned from the model card, NOT
verified by ear. Run tune.py, listen, and replace them.
Only keys in ALLOWED_INFERENCE_KEYS (app/config.py) are applied.

yuzuki._note: Soft and careful already — kept close to neutral.

reina._note: Fast, excitable reference. Lower cfg_weight to unhurry the pacing.

akira._note: Quiet deadpan. Slightly under neutral so it does not go flat.
